configs.label: persistence
configs.notes: No-AI controller — no actions are ever issued.

configs.notes: Deterministic rule-based FLISR; no learned control.

configs.label: dqn_core_only
configs.notes: DQN core only — no LSTM, no Twin, no Predictive, no reward shaping, no EMS, no XAI.

configs.notes: LSTM forecaster disabled; persistence fallback used.

configs.notes: Digital twin registry bypassed; no health-aware action selection.

configs.label: no_predictive
configs.notes: Predictive self-healing disabled; faults handled reactively by FLISR only.
